name: jiaowoplay
description: 交我PLAY - 线上小游戏聚合平台（首个游戏：同词相『交』）

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @jiaowoplay/shared && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @jiaowoplay/shared && npm run build --workspace @jiaowoplay/server && npm run build --workspace @jiaowoplay/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @jiaowoplay/shared && npm run test --workspace @jiaowoplay/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @jiaowoplay/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
